title: Neutrino Forge toolchain provisioning receipt (v1)
description: What ONE machine provisioned for the `requires-forge` acceptance rows: OS/arch, the Foundry `forge` identity (version, upstream commit, binary digest), the native dependencies of its Mach-O closure with the prefix they actually resolve from and their digests, and the LLVM/MLIR + solc coordinates that produced the artifacts forge consumes. The absolute paths RECORD a machine; they are never the mechanism — scripts/gates/check_forge_toolchain.py derives them (NEUTRINO_FORGE_LIBRARY_PATH, else `brew --prefix <declaredNativeFormula>`/lib on Darwin). Emitted by `--emit-receipt`, re-checked by `--verify-receipt` ().

commitSha.description: upstream Foundry commit the release was cut from

declaredNativeLibraryPath.description: The prefix handed to the dynamic loader at the direct forge spawn boundary. Empty when the closure resolves without one (Linux).

declaredNativeFormula.description: The package NAME the declared prefix is derived from, never a literal path.

nativeDependencies.description: Non-system Mach-O load commands of the forge binary — the closure this receipt provisions.

recordedInstallName.description: the absolute path baked into the binary by its builder

resolvedPath.description: where the loader actually finds it on this machine; null = unresolved (infrastructure failure)
